t: Malta Public Transport announces special services for Rabat Sacrum
html:
Malta Public Transport will be operating a special bus service for the Rabat Sacrum cultural event being held this Saturday 20th and Sunday 21st September 2025. This service, which is available for free for Tallinja Card holders, will operate between Infetti and Rabat Terminus, including a stop at Saqqajja.

This will ensure visitors can travel to and from the heart of this event, during which churches, historical landmarks and several of Rabat’s hidden treasures will be open to the public.

Travel on this service will be free of charge for Tallinja Card holders, while passengers without a Tallinja Card may purchase tickets for €3 per trip directly on board, with both cash and contactless payments accepted.
